cost_note: Estimates use pilot rates and reported tokens, without separate cache discounts. Blank costs indicate unknown pricing or incomplete usage. Scenario totals count terminal responses only. api_attempts.jsonl also records interruptions.
latency_note: Reconstructed from terminal request durations. Routed latency is Jev plus LLM. Excludes retry delays, queueing, and orchestration. P95 uses nearest rank.
scoring_note: Every test row counts. Missing predictions are wrong and contribute false negatives for macro-F1. Invalid routed LLM responses fall back to Jev.
